label: 욕망이야말로 진보라고 외친다
success_text_en: Applause pours in and the ratings graph soars.
fail_text: 너무 외운 티가 나서 패널들이 비웃습니다.
fail_text_en: It sounds rehearsed, and the panel sneers.

label: 절제의 가치를 차분히 설명한다
label_en: Calmly explain the value of temperance
success_text_en: The broadcast flops, but your heart is calm.

label: 공개 지지를 환영한다
success_text: 추문조차 매력으로 통하는 세상, 팬들이 몰려옵니다.
success_text_en: In a world where scandal is charm, his fans flock in.
fail_text: 검찰 발표 직후 당신 이름도 기사에 실립니다.
fail_text_en: Right after the prosecutors' briefing, your name hits the papers too.

label: 거리를 두는 성명을 낸다
label_en: Issue a statement keeping your distance
success_text_en: Comments brand you a 'stuffy old cult.'

label: 사실 지갑을 노렸다고 둘러댄다
label_en: Claim you were actually after the wallet
success_text_en: 'A real player after all,' and opinion turns.
fail_text_en: The lie is exposed too, and you are mocked twice over.

label: 당당히 정직을 인정한다
success_text: 밈이 되었지만 지갑 주인이 몰래 감사 편지를 보냅니다.
success_text_en: You become a meme, but the owner secretly mails you a thank-you note.

label: 밈 굿즈를 만들어 판다
success_text_en: The 'Fool' T-shirts sell like hotcakes.
fail_text_en: Only a mountain of unsold stock remains.

label: 명품 쇼핑 사진을 급히 연출한다
label_en: Stage a luxury shopping photo shoot
success_text_en: A rebuttal piece calls you 'an icon of excess.'
fail_text: 가격표를 떼지 않은 게 찍혀 반품족이라 놀림받습니다.
fail_text_en: The price tags show in the photos, and you're mocked as a serial returner.

label: 기자에게 입막음 돈을 건넨다
success_text_en: The article quietly vanishes.
fail_text_en: The reporter runs the envelope as a bonus scoop.

label: 검소함을 인정한다
success_text_en: Amid the jeers, your bank account stays healthy.

label: 끝까지 먹어 치운다
success_text_en: The crowd gives you a standing ovation.
fail_text_en: You collapse on live TV and leave by ambulance.

label: 한 입씩만 맛본다
label_en: Take only a bite of each
success_text_en: They nickname you 'the Dainty Guru.'

label: 더 큰 맞불 광고를 건다
success_text_en: Your billboard becomes a selfie hotspot.
fail_text_en: A typo in the ad turns it into a joke.

label: 명예훼손으로 고소한다
success_text_en: The court rules that 'incorruptible' is indeed an insult.
fail_text_en: The judge dismisses it as a statement of fact.

label: 모델 계약에 서명한다
success_text_en: The signing bonus outweighs the collection box.
fail_text_en: News breaks that the bank is near collapse.

label: 신도들에게 저축 대신 나눔을 권한다
label_en: Urge followers to give rather than save
success_text_en: A few are moved; most are baffled.

label: 유료 고급 뷔페로 바꾼다
label_en: Convert it into a premium buffet
success_text_en: The line grows twice as long.
fail_text: 음식 맛이 그대로라 손님이 금방 끊깁니다.
fail_text_en: The food is unchanged, and customers soon stop coming.

label: 벌금을 내고 계속 운영한다
label_en: Pay the fine and keep it running
success_text: 굶던 이들이 몰래 당신 이름을 부르며 기도합니다.
success_text_en: The hungry quietly pray in your name.

label: 코인을 발행한다
success_text_en: On listing day the price shoots through the roof.
fail_text: 대표가 해외로 잠적하고 신도들 지갑만 비었습니다.
fail_text_en: The CEO flees abroad, leaving only empty follower wallets.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: You're called 'the fool who kicked away a fortune.'

label: 장부를 일부러 복잡하게 꾸민다
success_text_en: The auditor leaves satisfied that you're 'a normal cult.'
fail_text_en: You're so clumsy it's flagged as real evasion.

label: 투명하게 모두 공개한다
success_text: 정직 가산세라는 처음 듣는 세금이 붙습니다.
success_text_en: You're hit with a never-before-heard 'honesty surcharge.'

label: 제휴를 맺는다
success_text_en: Followers swipe their cards as if in competition.
fail_text_en: A points glitch triggers a flood of complaints.

label: 쇼핑 중독을 경고하는 설교를 한다
success_text_en: You're banned from the lounge.

label: 전액을 받는다
success_text: 교단 금고가 넘치지만 가족들이 앙심을 품습니다.
success_text_en: The coffers overflow, but the family holds a grudge.

label: 가족에게 절반을 돌려준다
success_text_en: Followers whisper about 'the guru who takes a loss.'

label: 한 푼도 받지 않는다
success_text: 그 신도는 감동했지만 언론은 당신을 무능하다 합니다.
success_text_en: He is moved, but the press calls you incompetent.

label: 고리로 긴급 대출을 해준다
label_en: Offer emergency loans at steep interest
success_text_en: You're hailed as 'a true business cult.'
fail_text_en: The borrowers vanish en masse.

label: 무이자로 빌려준다
success_text_en: Economists cry 'market distortion,' but some people stay.

label: 화려한 입단식을 연다
success_text_en: His entire fandom follows him in.
fail_text: 입단식 다음 날 그가 다른 교단으로 옮깁니다.
fail_text_en: The day after the ceremony he hops to another cult.

label: 수행부터 시키겠다고 말한다
label_en: Insist he start with ascetic training
success_text_en: Surprisingly, he endures quietly.
fail_text_en: Headlines scream 'Guru starves idol.'

label: 뇌물 후보를 지지한다
success_text_en: You're a VIP at his victory party.
fail_text: 그가 낙선하고 당신만 줄을 잘못 선 셈이 됩니다.
fail_text_en: He loses, and you're the one who bet wrong.

label: 공약 후보를 지지한다
success_text: 기적처럼 당선되어 시청이 당신 말을 듣습니다.
success_text_en: He wins by a miracle, and city hall listens to you.
fail_text_en: He loses with 3%, and you're dubbed 'the fool who read platforms.'

label: 중립을 지킨다
success_text_en: Both sides resent you.

label: 밤새 파티를 후원한다
success_text_en: You win first place and freshmen pour in.
fail_text_en: Noise complaints shut the festival down.

label: 조용한 명상 부스를 연다
success_text: 부스엔 피곤한 교수 두 명만 다녀갑니다.
success_text_en: Only two exhausted professors visit the booth.

label: 봉사가 홍보 전략이었다고 해명한다
label_en: Explain it was a PR stunt
success_text_en: 'Calculating as ever,' and some return.
fail_text_en: Even the villagers feel betrayed.

label: 떠난 이들을 붙잡지 않는다
success_text_en: Those who stay look at you with firmer eyes.

label: 가장 화려한 신도를 내보낸다
success_text_en: She wins and shouts your cult's name.
fail_text_en: She gets the villain edit from episode one.

label: 출연을 거절한다
success_text: 제작진이 '방송 분량이 안 나오는 교단'이라며 투덜댑니다.
success_text_en: The producers grumble that your cult 'gives them no footage.'

label: 전단지 문구를 '더 가져라'로 바꾼다
success_text_en: The flyers run out in minutes.
fail_text: 행인들이 전단지 대신 경품만 챙겨 갑니다.
fail_text_en: Passersby take the giveaways and skip the flyers.

label: 신참을 위로하고 함께 다시 나간다
label_en: Comfort the rookie and go out together
success_text_en: You both come back soaked but laughing.

label: 한 번도 없다고 단언한다
success_text_en: The lawmakers nod in relief.
fail_text_en: A recording of you refusing one surfaces.

label: 거절한 적이 있다고 인정한다
success_text_en: The chamber erupts, and you land on a 'dangerous persons' list.

label: 그들보다 더 사치스러운 연회를 연다
label_en: Throw a feast more lavish than theirs
success_text_en: The executives marvel and swear loyalty.
fail_text_en: You blow the budget and the plot continues.

label: 공개 석상에서 해임한다
success_text_en: The cult falls silent and obeys.
fail_text: 해임된 간부들이 신도 일부를 데리고 나갑니다.
fail_text_en: The dismissed take a chunk of followers with them.

label: 대화로 설득한다
success_text_en: After a long night, you understand each other.
fail_text_en: Calling you 'all talk,' they move up the plot.

label: 이름을 큼지막하게 새긴다
label_en: Engrave his name in giant letters
success_text_en: Tour buses start stopping at your gates.

label: 십자가를 소박하게 바꾼다
label_en: Replace it with a modest cross
success_text_en: The chief clicks his tongue at your 'anachronism.'

label: 단속 명단을 작성해 준다
success_text_en: The police start treating you with deference.
fail_text_en: The chief's own mother was on the list.

label: 착한 이들을 몰래 숨겨 준다
success_text_en: Those hidden are deeply grateful to your cult.
fail_text_en: You're caught and investigated for 'harboring virtue.'

label: 본보기로 강등한다
success_text: 간부들은 만족했지만 아무도 실수를 보고하지 않게 됩니다.
success_text_en: The executives are satisfied, but no one reports mistakes again.

label: 정직을 칭찬하고 감싸 준다
label_en: Praise his honesty and protect him
success_text_en: Your aide, teary-eyed, swears loyalty.

label: 더 큰 야망을 불어넣는다
label_en: Fan a bigger ambition in him
success_text: 그가 경쟁사를 인수하며 당신을 은인이라 부릅니다.
success_text_en: He buys a rival and calls you his benefactor.
fail_text: 그가 과로로 쓰러지고 가족이 당신을 원망합니다.
fail_text_en: He collapses from overwork, and his family blames you.

label: 만족도 괜찮다고 말해 준다
success_text: 그는 화를 내며 계약을 끊었지만 그날 밤 푹 잡니다.
success_text_en: He storms off and cancels, but sleeps soundly that night.

label: 고행 장을 빼고 출간한다
success_text_en: It's stacked at the front of every bookstore.
fail_text_en: A cover typo causes a recall.

label: 원본 그대로 고집한다
success_text_en: The 300-copy first run sleeps in a warehouse.

label: 반박 영상을 찍는다
success_text_en: You win the debate and gain subscribers.
fail_text_en: The comments are flooded with 'broke guru.'

label: 그의 논리를 교리에 흡수한다
label_en: Absorb his argument into your doctrine
success_text_en: Your doctrine trends but grows shallow.

label: 개정안을 통과시킨다
success_text_en: Followers cheer, but the scripture gets thinner.

label: 긴 토론회를 연다
success_text_en: After the debate, the original is actually strengthened.
fail_text_en: The professors walk out, calling it tedious.

label: 직접 랩을 한다
success_text_en: Your unexpected flow brings the judges to their feet.
fail_text_en: You forget the lyrics and suffer national humiliation.

label: 경전을 낭독만 한다
success_text: 첫 회 탈락이지만 한 시청자가 손편지를 보냅니다.
success_text_en: Eliminated in round one, but one viewer sends a handwritten letter.

label: 교리를 '자기 몫부터'로 고친다
success_text_en: The press praises you for 'finally growing up.'

label: 소송비를 교단이 대신 낸다
success_text_en: The doctrine stands, but the coffers lighten.

label: '더 먹어라' 구절을 고른다
success_text_en: The bread sells out and the verse becomes a catchphrase.

label: '배고픔을 기억하라' 구절을 고른다
success_text: 빵은 안 팔리지만 노숙인 쉼터에 기부됩니다.
success_text_en: The bread doesn't sell, but goes to a homeless shelter.

label: 시상식을 크게 연다
success_text_en: It's a night of nonstop laughter.
fail_text: 수상자 선정에 불만을 품은 신도들이 싸웁니다.
fail_text_en: Disgruntled followers brawl over the winners.

label: '가장 많이 나눈 사람' 상을 몰래 추가한다
success_text_en: The winner blushes through polite applause.

label: 공개 경쟁을 붙인다
success_text: 승부가 교단의 화젯거리가 되고 패자도 웃습니다.
success_text_en: The contest becomes the talk of the cult, and even the loser laughs.
fail_text_en: They form factions and split the cult.

label: 둘을 앉혀 화해시킨다
label_en: Sit them down and reconcile them
success_text_en: They forget the influencer and become friends.
fail_text_en: They just call you a preachy bore.

label: 배달 음식을 잔뜩 시킨다
success_text_en: Bellies full, the followers throw their arms around each other.

label: 나눈 신도를 공개 칭찬한다
success_text_en: Those who laughed look sheepish.
fail_text_en: He gets teased even more.

label: 교주가 1초 만에 먹어 보인다
success_text_en: The clip spreads and followers double over laughing.

label: 15분을 참아 보인다
success_text: 당신이 왕따가 되었지만 묘한 존경도 섞여 있습니다.
success_text_en: You're the outcast now, though with an odd note of respect.

label: 곧바로 신나는 곡으로 이어 부른다
label_en: Jump in with an upbeat song
success_text: 분위기가 살아나고 그 신도도 함께 춤춥니다.
success_text_en: The mood revives and the follower dances along.
fail_text_en: You miss the beat and make it more awkward.

label: 성가를 함께 부른다
success_text_en: A few quietly join in.

label: 모두 참여시킨다
success_text_en: Sharing secrets makes them close as family.
fail_text_en: The diary leaks to the outside world.

label: 자율 참여로 둔다
success_text_en: Only a few pages quietly get filled.

label: 계시로 받아들이고 주문한다
label_en: Take it as revelation and order
success_text: 택배 상자를 열자 이상한 확신이 차오릅니다.
success_text_en: Opening the box, a strange certainty fills you.

label: TV를 끄고 기도를 이어 간다
label_en: Turn it off and keep praying
success_text: 고요 속에서 진짜 목소리가 들리는 듯합니다.
success_text_en: In the silence you seem to hear the real voice.
fail_text: 다시 켜고 싶은 충동에 기도가 흐트러집니다.
fail_text_en: The urge to turn it back on scatters your prayer.

label: 투자 감각을 칭찬한다
success_text: 아이가 수익 일부를 헌금합니다. 마음 한쪽이 허전합니다.
success_text_en: He donates part of the profit. Something feels hollow.

label: 공부에 쓰라고 다독인다
label_en: Gently urge him to use it for school
success_text_en: The boy nods and heads back to school.
fail_text_en: He snorts and calls you a dinosaur.

label: 호텔로 간다
success_text_en: On the plush bed, faith is briefly forgotten.

label: 수행을 지킨다
success_text_en: Social media mocks you as 'the one who wasted a hotel voucher.'

label: 숙박권을 경매에 부친다
success_text_en: It sells for twice the estimate.
fail_text_en: The winning bidder skips out on payment.

label: 욕망이 곧 신이라고 다짐한다
label_en: Resolve that desire itself is God
success_text_en: Your eyes blaze.

label: 답이 나올 때까지 침묵한다
label_en: Stay silent until an answer comes
success_text: 새벽녘 가슴 속에서 작은 확신이 자랍니다.
success_text_en: Toward dawn, a small certainty grows in your chest.
fail_text_en: The face in the mirror becomes a stranger's.

label: 칭찬을 즐긴다
success_text: 박수 소리 뒤에서 기도문이 기억나지 않습니다.
success_text_en: Behind the applause, you can't recall the prayer.

label: 진짜 믿음을 고백하는 글을 쓴다
label_en: Write a confession of true faith
success_text_en: Reviews pan your 'weak acting.'

label: 랍스터 사진을 빌려 올린다
success_text_en: Likes pour in and followers are thrilled.
fail_text_en: The original photographer calls out the source.

label: 김밥 사진을 그대로 올린다
label_en: Post the rice roll photo as is
success_text_en: Rumors spread that you've gone bankrupt.

label: 숫자를 부풀린 2차 보고서를 낸다
success_text_en: Followers feel proud again.
fail_text_en: The accountant blows the whistle.

label: 검소함이 강점이라고 설득한다
label_en: Argue that thrift is a strength
success_text_en: A few nod along.
fail_text_en: All you hear is yawning.

label: 공개적으로 축하해 준다
success_text_en: Followers cheer you as 'the cult of freedom.'

label: 조용히 연락해 안부를 묻는다
label_en: Quietly call to check on him
success_text_en: For the first time, he chokes up and opens his heart.

label: 공개 만찬으로 소문을 잠재운다
label_en: Quash it with a public banquet
success_text_en: Seeing you feast, followers relax.
fail_text_en: Indigestion forces you to leave mid-banquet.

label: 금식이 사실이라고 인정한다
success_text: 신도 몇몇이 걱정 어린 눈으로 죽을 끓여 옵니다.
success_text_en: A few worried followers bring you porridge.

label: 역대급 불꽃놀이를 쏜다
success_text_en: The sky turns gold and followers go wild.
fail_text_en: A spark lands on a neighbor's roof.

label: 촛불 명상을 연다
success_text_en: Most doze off, but a few shed tears.

label: 탈세 컨설턴트를 소개해 준다
label_en: Introduce him to a tax-dodging consultant
success_text: 그가 새 직장에서 '감각 있는 신입'으로 환영받습니다.
success_text_en: At his new job he's welcomed as 'a savvy hire.'

label: 교단에서 일자리를 마련해 준다
label_en: Give him a job in the cult
success_text_en: He works harder than anyone.

label: 과장된 예언을 쏟아낸다
success_text_en: A prophecy happens to land, and you're called 'the god of elections.'
fail_text_en: Every prophecy misses and becomes a meme.

label: 데이터대로 담담히 말한다
success_text: PD가 다음 선거엔 부르지 않겠다고 합니다.
success_text_en: The producer says you won't be invited next time.

label: 우물에 요금소를 단다
label_en: Install a toll on the well
success_text: 사장이 당신과 악수하고, 기도는 어딘가 공허해집니다.
success_text_en: The CEO shakes your hand, and your prayers ring hollow.

label: 적이라는 말을 훈장으로 여긴다
label_en: Wear 'enemy' as a badge of honor
success_text: 공짜 물을 마시는 아이들의 웃음이 신앙을 단단히 합니다.
success_text_en: The laughter of children drinking freely steels your faith.
